test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was appointed as the Director of the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) in May 2023?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Praveen Sood**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Praveen Sood** was appointed as the **Director of the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)** in May 2023.
 
• He succeeded **Subodh Kumar Jaiswal**, whose tenure ended in May 2023.
 
• **Praveen Sood** is a 1986-batch IPS officer of the **Karnataka cadre**.
 
• Before being appointed as the CBI Director, he served as the **Director General of Police (DGP) of Karnataka**.
 
• The Central Bureau of Investigation is one of the premier investigating agencies in India, functioning under the jurisdiction of the **Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances, and Pensions**.
 
• As CBI Director, **Praveen Sood** is tasked with overseeing high-profile investigations and maintaining the integrity of the agency.
 
• The appointment process for the CBI Director involves a high-powered committee consisting of the **Prime Minister, the Chief Justice of India, and the Leader of the Opposition** in the Lok Sabha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Debadatta Chand**__

 __
 
• **Debadatta Chand** is the Managing Director and CEO of **Bank of Baroda** as of May 2023.
 
• He is a senior banking professional with extensive experience in the financial sector.
 
 
 
• **Shantanu Roy**__
 __
 
• **Shantanu Roy** was appointed as the **Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) of BEML Limited** in May 2023.
 
• BEML Limited is a leading public sector company engaged in manufacturing heavy equipment and vehicles.
 
 
 
• **Rakesh Asthana**__
 
 
• **Rakesh Asthana** is a 1984-batch IPS officer who served as the **Commissioner of Delhi Police** and held other prominent positions in Indian law enforcement.
 
• He was also the **Director-General of the Border Security Force (BSF).**
